name: paper-garden

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsx scripts/build-sw.ts
scripts.e2e: playwright test --grep-invert "@perf|@sweep" && playwright test --grep @sweep --workers=3 && playwright test --grep @perf --workers=1

description: Paper Garden, a two-player garden game for phones, tablets and desktops.
